note: pixel coords in one shared space: drill_arm_*.png are 1536x1024, drill_body*.png are 1800x1100, same origin; angles in degrees, clockwise positive, relative to the assembled pose

arm_shadow.model: per joint: ground row interpolated by arm length from shoulder_ground (f=0) to drill tip in drill pose (f=1); h = groundY - jointY; shadow = (x + tx*h, groundY + ty*h); each segment affine-mapped onto its joints' shadow points, thickness k
